name: Remittances from family or associates to individuals in border areas
description: Recurrent small transfers to recipients in or near conflict zones with no clear family relationship or humanitarian need.
fp: Diaspora families routinely support relatives in affected regions.

sources.text: FATF, Financing of the Terrorist Organisation Islamic State in Iraq and the Levant (ISIL) (2015)
UN Security Council Resolution 2178 (2014) on foreign terrorist fighters
